result.summary: CI PYTHONPATH omits `src/`, so `foo.bar` resolves to a different package than locally.
result.hypothesis: Stale or conflicting package layout between local editable install and CI checkout.

likely_causes.title: PYTHONPATH / install mode mismatch
likely_causes.rationale: ImportError path points at repo file while local runs use editable install on sys.path.

likely_causes.title: Circular import in foo.bar
likely_causes.rationale: Possible but does not explain CI-only failure without accompanying traceback cycle.

recommended_next_steps: Align CI to use `pip install -e .` or set PYTHONPATH=src.
Add a CI job that imports `foo.bar` before tests run.
